_comment: Tests that must run whatever changed, because an import graph cannot see them. Each entry states why it is untraceable. Keep this list short: an entry here costs every branch the time to run it.

always_run.reason: reaches the handlers through tests/extension/shared/background-message-router.js, which mirrors init.ts wiring by hand; a dependency added in init.ts changes what the route delivers without changing anything this file imports, which is how the enhanced_action route was silently killed in two files
same hand-mirrored router; a dependency present in init.ts and absent from the mirror dies inside the handler switch, and no import edge exists from init.ts to here
compares entry points against each other by reading source text rather than importing them, so a new entry point or a diverging one is invisible to the graph
